title.rendered: Heart to HEART Online Auction Now Open

content.rendered:
Bidding is now open for the 2023 Heart To HEART Online Auction! Bidding is open through 8pm on Sunday, April 16th.

View the catalogue and make your bid using the link below:

auctria.events/scshearttoheart

The proceeds from this event will help to make an immediate impact in supporting SCS!

Winner Pick Up Event: SCS on Saturday, April 22 10:00 am – 12:00 pm
